author: Victoria Romeo
text: Matt and his team were a pleasure to work with. He took on the job of decommissioning our septic tank and connecting our home into the new sewer system. Not only was the work completed on the timeline he set, but we had no interruption to our household needs throughout the process. He did an excellent job (and my husband is an extremely hard-to-please engineer) and regarded and reseeded our lawn perfectly. I would absolutely hire him again or recommend him to family and friends!

author: Chris Wright
text: MG Septic is the ultimate company for septic diagnosis and repair. They can answer any questions about septic issue. And can finish the job quickly and efficiently.

author: Rebecca Lewis
text: The MG Septic team were great! Fair pricing, amazing communication throughout the whole process, and would happily recommend when needing a septic tank needs replacing.

author: Marcus Fronczek
text: MG Septic did a fantastic job, twice.  First, when our 20 year old leach field stopped draining and we needed to install a new raised bed system with a pump chamber.  Second, When they took care of a major water drainage issue on our property, by installing a curtain drain.  Their quality of work was excellent and professional and have certainly earned my recommendation.

author: Michelle Becker
text:
Our only complaint is that the appt/evaluation of our septic system cost us almost $500, only to tell us what another septic person told us, same information but that company didn't charge us for the evaluation. I can understand time and gas etc. but they are a local company who didn't have to travel far to look at the system.

Other than that, the communication was good, the appt. to look at our system was made relatively quickly and the team was knowledgeable.

It would have been nice to not be charged so much for a simple evaluation and then on top of that, if you don't pay the fee in 10 days, they charge you an additional $250 until you pay the fee in full which is ridiculous. I feel like people who are caught off guard and may not realize these fees could rack up a huge debt if it is not paid right away.
